headline: Canadian Astronaut to Share Artemis II Journey in Upcoming Book
meta_description: Canadian astronaut Jeremy Hansen plans to publish a book documenting his experience on the Artemis II mission, sharing insights from this historic spaceflight.
summary_short: Canadian astronaut Jeremy Hansen is writing a book about his upcoming Artemis II mission, bringing readers along on this landmark space journey.
body:
Canadian astronaut Jeremy Hansen will document his Artemis II mission experience in a forthcoming book, offering readers a firsthand account of the historic spaceflight.

The decision to publish his mission account reflects growing interest in personal narratives from space exploration. By sharing his journey through a book, Hansen will bring the experience of lunar missions closer to audiences worldwide, bridging the gap between public curiosity and the reality of modern spaceflight.

This initiative continues a tradition of astronauts reflecting on their experiences for broader audiences, combining scientific achievement with human storytelling.
quick_facts: Canadian astronaut Jeremy Hansen selected for Artemis II
Hansen to publish book detailing his mission experience
Book will feature firsthand account of Artemis II spaceflight
